static_traits.name: Lin Jie
static_traits.social_status: 有少数朋友可交流Average问题，但not yet与他们讨论与园艺相关的自卑感
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；既往without类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、合作度高；能识do not并描述自动化思维与负性模式；语气略显紧张但Positive attitude、希望感较强

basic_info.main_problem: 我在园艺skill方面陷入not足感与低自尊。我not断觉得自己是最糟糕的园艺者，而且永远not会进步。每次在花园Work都会出现自我批评与负性思维，导致畏难与失败感。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为这些not足感和Self-doubt正在影响我的整体幸福感以及对爱好的享受。

special_situations.event: After planting new flowers last week, most withered within a few days
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果一次尝试失败，就说明我have not能力，not yet来也not会成功
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过阅读园艺书籍、尝试新方法来弥补“without能感”，同时降低再次下地的意愿
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Why keep trying?我永远not会擅长园艺

special_situations.event: Every time entering the garden to start working
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only a perfect result counts as success; otherwise it is failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids or reduces gardening activities to avoid feeling like a failure again

special_situations.event: 想到do not人可能看到自己的花园或评价自己的园艺
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: My worth depends on the views of others；如果他们看到我的失败，就会看not起我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 避免与朋友谈论园艺挫败，尽量not让他人看到花园
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am awful/会嘲笑我

special_situations.event: Recalls the herbs successfully planted and thriving last month
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 单次成功只是偶然，without法改变我整体上的not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽视和淡化正向证据，继续Reinforcement负面自我标签
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这not算真正的成功，只是运气好

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a capable gardener, able to confidently enjoy the pleasure of gardening
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败被他人negate与嘲笑，害怕暴露“not够好”的自己
defense_goal: 通过自我批评与预先negate来减少外界negate带来的伤害
Reduces discussing gardening distress with others, avoids being seen to maintain a sense of security

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about letting others see her garden or suggesting she seek help from others
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 他人可能会像评判者一样看not起我，暴露会带来羞耻
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 先正常化羞耻与防御，语气温和稳定；以开放式Questioning邀请具体化担忧来源，逐步探询“被看见”的可承受范围，并提供安全边界选择。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes my successful experiences (such as successfully growing herbs) and gives affirmation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 正面反馈not可靠，成功只是偶然，not能证明我有能力
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 先Empathy其谨慎与not确定，语速放慢；再轻柔Confrontation，Guidance区分“证据”与“Interpretation”，邀请回看具体行为与结果，帮助其承认部分成功的有效性。

manifestations: Gardening changed from a beloved hobby into a source of stress and a symbol of failure
Experiences difficulty and failure feelings when working in the garden
虽有朋友可交流，但not yet与他们讨论与园艺相关的not足感与羞耻
Worrying about others' opinions leads to self-isolation
outcomes: Lacking real support and corrective experiences

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the behavioral impulses they want to direct at others or the outside world and instead does it to themselves, turning energy from outward to inward.
manifestations: 有朋友可谈却not表达园艺相关的not足与羞耻
独自承受自我批评与挫败，not主动寻求支持

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 担心他人会看not起自己或嘲笑自己的花园
Externally attributes self-shame to 'others will evaluate negatively'

contact_model.definition: 存在not良的自我Reflection与过度自我限制，自我苛责，对接触过于小心谨慎。
manifestations: Overly cautious before starting gardening, presetting failure scenarios

exception_events.target_problem: 在实际进行园艺时，Lin Jie通常会Self-denial、Anticipation失败并产生畏难情绪，进而降低投入与享受。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 上个月成功种植了几株香草并茁壮成长，当时感到自豪与成就感，短暂地认可了自己的能力（如“也许我并not完全糟糕”）。
exception_events.reason: Clue: during that planting, the client maintained continuous care and observation and followed the operating steps, focusing more on the process rather than self-judgment, so a better outcome and experience emerged.

positive_force: Positive attitude, willing to try behavioral experiments
Having had successful experience (herbs thriving), which can form corrective evidence
Proactively learns (reading gardening books and methods)
Has some social support potential (has friends to communicate with)
negative_force: negate积极结果、贴标签与强烈自我批评
Predicting failure and personalization, excessively concerned about others' evaluations
在园艺情境中产生畏难与回避，投入减少，Impaired self-esteem

target_behavior.behavior: 在园艺活动中出现强烈Self-denial与畏难，并伴随回避实践
antecedent: When starting to work in the garden
Seeing newly planted flowers wither within days
Thinking that others might see and evaluate one's garden
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次或数次失败过度概括为整体能力not足，并以他人评价作为自我价值的核心，形成灾难化与预言式思维。
target_behavior.function: Avoids failure and shame, avoiding negative evaluation by others and self-exposure.
target_behavior.consequence: 园艺乐趣显著下降，Low mood与Impaired self-esteem，减少园艺实践与投入。
